constitution.purpose: To run the jurisprudential cycle that outside law increasingly bypasses: claim, answer, adversarial test, judgment, record, revision.

invariant.statement: Validity, never origin, is the test. No claim prevails because of who brought it; no claim fails because of where it came from.
invariant.reason: The room exists because the outside law inverted this invariant. The room is its restoration — and §11.6 names what happens if the room ever forgets.
invariant.access: Whoever can be meant can be heard.

operator.name: σ_MOOT
terms: ā — the answer. An answer is mandatory; no matter proceeds against silence except as Rule 9 provides.

∮ — the Adversary General’s verification. Nobel Glas’s Lagrange condition, inherited whole from the Observatory: the matter must wind both directions of the torus, m + n ≥ 3. No judgment from a single loop.
ρ — the report. Judgment deposited, anchored, citable, versioned.
operator.appellate: Versioning is the appellate mechanism. An appeal is σ_MOOT applied to a judgment, producing the next version of the reported document; reversal is a v2 that says so. Overruling is the negative tag.
operator.nunc_pro_tunc: σ_RCF ∘ σ_MOOT — the retrocausal canon-formation operator applied to adjudications that occurred before the court existed, receiving them into its reports as pre-constitutional case law, the way custom was received into common law.
operator.status: Entered into the operator register as provisional, pending the next versioning of EA-ARK-01.

bench: He does jurisprudence; the register says so. The presiding voice writes the judgment but cannot issue it alone.

constitution.lagrange_inheritance: The verification condition is inherited whole from R:r.15: the matter must wind both directions of the torus, m + n ≥ 3. A judgment reached by a single loop is not a judgment. The Observatory’s anti-summarization topology becomes the court’s standard of proof.
